cleaner.label: Deep Scan
cleaner.description: Scan and clean specific file types widely scattered across the disk

option.label: Temporary files (.tmp)
option.description: Delete temporary files scattered across user directories
option.warning: This option performs a deep disk scan and may take a few minutes.

option.label: Backup files (.bak)
option.description: Delete backup files generated by text editors and applications
option.warning: Inspect the preview before cleaning. This will delete .bak and ~ backup files.

option.label: Thumbs.db cache files
option.description: Delete hidden Windows thumbnail database cache files

option.label: .DS_Store metadata files
option.description: Delete legacy macOS metadata files leftover from transfers

option.label: Node.js Dependencies (node_modules)
option.description: Delete node_modules dependency packages in developer workspaces
option.warning: CRITICAL WARNING: This will delete node_modules directories across projects. Ongoing software development environments will require running 'npm install' or 'yarn' to restore.

option.label: Python Virtual Environments (venv)
option.description: Delete Python virtual environment folders (.venv / venv)
option.warning: CRITICAL WARNING: This will delete Python virtual environments, requiring them to be recreated in active development environments.

option.label: Python Bytecode Cache (__pycache__ / .pyc)
option.description: Delete compiled Python bytecode directories and .pyc files
option.warning: CRITICAL WARNING: Deleting cache files in active developer projects may temporarily slow down Python executions.
